name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+4

- TV app: browse Movies & TV on the TV, synced from the phone
  - The phone sends the TV your Stremio sign-in, addons, Movies & TV rows (your Edit layout order), the TMDB key and the watched point, locked with AES-256-GCM. The key only reaches the TV through LG's own phone link when the phone opens the TV app.
  - New TV screens: Home rows with a backdrop and details of the highlighted title, details with seasons and episodes, a streams panel, search, settings. All with the LG remote; works when the phone is away.
  - Plays debrid and direct streams on the TV by itself (torrent-only and header streams are left out). Up in the player opens audio and subtitles (addon subtitles included).
  - Progress goes to the Stremio library like the phone does it; resume points; the next episode starts by itself with the same kind of stream. Watched marks go to the phone, which sets the Stremio mark and updates AniList and Simkl.
  - TV Remote page: sync status, Sync now, and a search box that types on the TV.
  - scripts/tv_smoke.js walks the TV app through all of it without a TV; runs in checks.
